what: When a hand hovers over a panel (video box · photo), award badges and star-rating chips hidden around it pop out at their own angle ±40° in .7s back.out(2.6) in random order (.07 apart) and stand at .5→1 scale, then after all are up they sway ±4° for 1.4~2s. When the hand leaves, they shrink to .6 in .2s and vanish (random .03). Badges are pushed away from the mouse by their own depth px over .9s power3.out, creating depth

options.[data-fx-part=pop]: Per badge — data-r is the line angle (deg), data-d is the distance pushed by the mouse (px, default 20)
options.[data-fx-part=host]: Hover plate (optional) — whole element if omitted
options.spin: Extra rotation angle (deg) when popping out, default 40
options.depth: Offset (px) of badges without data-d, default 20

use: Video
note: On devices with no pointer input or with reduced motion, the badge is shown upright from the start. The original retires the badge once the video box starts growing on scroll (progress past 10%) — the consumer sends pointerleave at that point or removes data-fx.

from.where: index.js six badges around the hero video box (original hero_pop — data-r, data-d, back.out(2.6) .7s random .07, ±40°, sway ±4° 1.4+(i%3)×.3s, exit .2s scale .6 random .03, mouse push .9s power3.out)
